mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 30 degrees under clear skies at the Verona Area High School, accompanied by a Waxing Crescent moon. The overnight low will hit 29 degrees, and we have no rain in the forecast.

City officials are currently evaluating several development proposals, including plans for the Liberty Business Park, while also sharing important notices for the upcoming general elections and recreation department league standings.
There are currently no scheduled events on the municipal calendar for the next 30 days, though you can check the City of Verona website for future updates.
On October 25th, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of a vehicle stopped at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where they arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I.

Today's featured flavor was the Caramel Cashew, but since the restaurant is currently closed for the night, keep an eye out for tomorrow's Flavor of the Day, Mint Explosion, when the store opens at 10:00 AM.
